comment.body: Thanks for the exact example: 10_Test_Folder becomes _Test_Folder. Current New+ intentionally removes leading digits when Hide starting digits, spaces, and dots is enabled, and that option is enabled by default. Please confirm whether the setting is on in PowerToys Settings > New+, then retry the same folder name with it disabled. If digits are still removed while the option is off, reply with that result and the New+ version; that distinguishes a code issue from configured behavior.
